target.title: Apply Claw MCP server artifacts
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Claws can already apply plugin and skill artifacts, but `mcpServer` entries still stop at preview/unsupported behavior. That leaves starter Claws unable to configure the MCP servers that often make a setup runnable.

This is the MCP server installer follow-up from openclaw/rfcs#27 and stacks on #102383.

## Why This Change Was Made

- Adds an inline MCP server artifact source: a `mcpServer` entry uses its `id` as the OpenClaw-managed MCP server name and a JSON object `selector` as the server config.
- Delegates writes through the existing validated `mcp.servers` config path used by `openclaw mcp set`.
- Keeps non-inline MCP selectors, such as future ClawHub MCP packages, unsupported/skipped until a resolver exists.
- Fails closed on name conflicts instead of overwriting existing different MCP server config.
- Records MCP artifact provenance only after verified config writes, with digest-based artifact keys/selectors so inline config secrets are not persisted in Claw state or apply/status JSON.

## User Impact

A user can apply a Claw that includes an inline MCP server config and have OpenClaw save the matching `mcp.servers.<name>` entry. Existing matching config is idempotent; existing different config blocks with a diagnostic instead of being overwritten.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/claws/schema.test.ts src/claws/provenance.test.ts src/claws/artifact-installers.test.ts src/cli/claws-cli.test.ts src/claws/lifecycle.e2e.test.ts`
- Real CLI proof: `claws apply <inline-mcp-only claw> --yes --json` wrote `mcp.servers.docs`, recorded one artifact ref, and returned digest-only MCP artifact identity fields.
- `git diff --check`
- `node scripts/check-no-conflict-markers.mjs`
- `codex review -c model=gpt-5.5 --uncommitted` reported no actionable correctness issues after fixes for non-inline MCP handling, artifact identity, config overwrite conflicts, and secret-safe provenance.

Known gap: `pnpm exec tsgo --noEmit --pretty false` is still blocked by inherited `src/secrets/config-io.ts(12,17)` TS4058, outside this Claws diff.

Stack refs: RFC openclaw/rfcs#27, previous PR #102383.
